snippet.title: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux | Announcement Trailer | Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 - October 29
snippet.description:
The Spectrum Retreat: Redux comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on 29th October 2026. 

Wishlist now on the Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-spectrum-retreat-redux-switch-2/

Redux is a ground-up rebuild of Dan Smith's BAFTA-winning first-person puzzle game.

You're a guest at The Penrose, an art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world and run by android staff. With only a stranger's voice to guide you, you start trying to work out why you're there. To get through the hotel you absorb and swap colours to pass security barriers and redirect energy. Underneath it all is a story about memory, grief and a family let down by the systems that were meant to protect them.

New on Nintendo Switch 2:
- Overhauled lighting and reflections, with new volumetric effects
- Refined HDR support
- Mouse controls
- HD Rumble 2 and enhanced 5.1 surround sound
- Chapter select, faster traversal, and performance and gameplay improvements

Own the original on Nintendo Switch?
Redux is a separate release, not a patch or a Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade. However, if you own The Spectrum Retreat on Nintendo Switch, you get the full Redux release at 100% off at launch via an automatic eShop Owner Discount.

Pricing: 
£9.99 / $12.99 / €12.99

Developed by Dan Smith Studios and Ripstone.
Published by Ripstone.

https://www.ripstone.com
https://www.dansmithstudios.com
Press: press@ripstone.com
